$comment: Per-dialect capability descriptor. An agent reads this AFTER the http-mcp `transports` tool tells it git-broker is adapter-provided. Declares how this dialect maps down onto the wire's two atoms.

maps_to.propose: CALL (http_request) — the far end commits commands/<ulid>.json (an envelope carrying exactly one httpx.Request) into the shared bridge repo
maps_to.fire: CALL (http_request) — the poller fires the envelope's CALL through the witness (8 collector /fetch), which stamps X-8-Witness
maps_to.receipt: CALL (http_request) — the poller commits receipts/<ulid>.json back; the far end learns the outcome by pulling (a queue = CALL-post + CALL-poll)

capability_shaped: store-and-forward over git commits (pull → process → commit → push), idempotent by receipt existence
authority split: far end PROPOSES, host-side Policy DECIDES; -policy is REQUIRED, must live OUTSIDE the bridge checkout, and a missing file is CLOSED (no AllowAll default)
HALT: <bridge>/state/halt is the far end's revocation, checked immediately before EVERY fire; a halted poll leaves envelopes unanswered until it is lifted
auth_slot resolution host-side (-slots, must be OUTSIDE the bridge) — no credential ever enters the public bridge
inbound gate (internal/guard): request headers are an ALLOWLIST; URLs with userinfo or credential-named query params (?access_key=) are rejected structurally

thick receipts: status, ALLOWLISTED headers (Content-Type, Content-Length, X-8-*), capped body + full-body sha256, latency, X-8-Witness/Ledger-Id/DMs; a slot-authenticated call publishes only the digest unless the policy opts in (egress.authenticated_body)
why_not_wire: A git repo is a substrate, not a shape. Reduction rule 4: a queue is CALL-post + CALL-poll for classification, never a CHANNEL in physics — a commit holds no connection, so CHANNEL collapses into CALL and the adapter must carry the whole afferent leg in the receipt. The wire only ever sees one http_request per envelope; git, schemas, policy and slot resolution are the adapter's.
shape_proven_by: gitbroker_test.go — envelope committed into a temp bridge repo → polled → fired as one CALL through a witness stub (own both ends, stdlib + git binary) → thick receipt with the X-8-Witness line committed back; second poll is a no-op (idempotent). Security gate (#1145) proven: a policy/slots path inside the bridge refuses to start, a missing policy is closed, a Set-Cookie never enters the receipt, userinfo/?access_key=/X-Api-Key envelopes are refused, HALT stops the fire. Also `loopback gitbroker`.
